The '''Vestswe family''' hailed from the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core World]] of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]. More than forty generations before the end of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the Vestswes pledged allegiance to the [[House of Organa/Legends|Royal House of Alderaan]]. By [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], their descendant [[Sateen Vestswe/Legends|Sateen Vestswe]] still served the royalty in the person of [[Prince/Legends|Prince]] [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Prestor Organa]].<ref name="CSWE" />
